items.title: Puka Nacua: Optimism regarding Week 7 status
items.text:
The Rams are optimistic that Nacua (calf), who is listed as questionable for Week 7, will play in Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Breece Hall: Not likely to play Sunday
items.text:
Hall (quadriceps) is unlikely to suit up for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Slated to resume role as RB1
items.text:
Skattebo is expected to resume his role as the Giants' lead running back in Sunday's game at Houston, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Christian Kirk: Activated from injured reserve
items.text:
The 49ers activated Kirk (calf) from injured reserve and removed his questionable designation for Sunday's game in Atlanta.

items.title: Jordan Mason: Activated from IR, cleared for Week 7
items.text:
The Vikings activated Mason (thumb) from injured reserve Saturday, and he does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Colts.

items.title: Tank Dell: Activated from injured reserve
items.text:
Dell (knee) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, and his questionable designation has been removed for Sunday's game against the Giants.
